name: When should I contact a listing agent to sell my home?

mainEntity.name: When should I contact a listing agent to sell my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is advisable to contact a listing agent several months before you plan to put your home on the market. This allows ample time for a thorough property assessment, identification of any necessary repairs or improvements, and professional staging advice. Engaging an agent early in your timeline, especially in competitive markets across Collier or Orange County, ensures you have a strategic plan in place, potentially leading to a quicker and more profitable sale. You can also discuss market conditions and optimal listing times.
acceptedAnswer.description: Contact a listing agent a few months before selling to allow for property assessment, necessary preparations, and strategic planning.
